title: Definition.
bodyText: As used in this part, "community outreach board" means a board established to serve in a community advisory capacity under a county commission or a county department.
bodyHtml: [§92-84]  Definition.  As used in this part, "community outreach board" means a board established to serve in a community advisory capacity under a county commission or a county department. [L 2025, c 53, §2]
